text:
alex: Heads-up — got repeated GPU_EXPORTER_SCRAPE_FAIL alerts for us-east-1/gpu-pool. Prometheus shows scrape errors for dcgm/node-exporter sidecar on ~12 nodes.
maria: which error in the exporter logs? any permission denied or bind errors?
kyle: I pulled a couple logs: looks like exporter fails to create /var/run/dcgm/gpu.sock after systemd restart. Error: "bind: permission denied" then exporter exits.

alex: exact log snippet I saw:
```
2026-03-17T21:10:03Z ERROR server.go:112 bind unix /var/run/dcgm/gpu.sock: bind: permission denied
2026-03-17T21:10:03Z INFO shutdown complete
```

jamal: interesting — we recently changed node base image umask to be stricter (umask 0077) via cloud-init for security. That would leave socket files with 700 and owned by root, exporter running as "dcgm" user can't bind to an existing socket or create in dir if dir perms are tight.

maria: confirmed on one node: /var/run/dcgm exists mode 0700 owner root:root, exporter unit file lacks UMask or RuntimeDirectoryMode. systemd creates runtime dir as root by default.

kyle: workaround: restart systemd unit with RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755 or set UMask=0022 in the exporter.service, or run systemd-tmpfiles to create directory with proper perms. quick fix we applied: `sudo systemctl edit --full dcgm-exporter.service` and added `RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755` under [Service] and `User=dcgm`. Restarted and scrapes recovered.

alex: did that restore all nodes?

kyle: partial — we rolled to 6 nodes in canary, scrapes back, prometheus alert cleared for those. Still ~6 nodes left with old unit deployed by image (systemd configs baked in).

jamal: we should patch the init script that creates /var/run/dcgm to set mode 0755 and chown to dcgm:dcgm before exporter starts. Also add `UMask=0027` carefully if we want group perms preserved.

maria: agree. Also need a long-term fix in the node image: update cloud-init to `mkdir -p /var/run/dcgm && chown dcgm:dcgm /var/run/dcgm && chmod 0755 /var/run/dcgm` so node reboots don't regress.

kyle: I'll draft a PR with three changes: 1) exporter systemd unit add RuntimeDirectoryMode and explicit User, 2) cloud-init snippet for runtime dir creation, 3) prometheus alert tuning so transient failures during restart (5m window) don't page on-call. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/r1234 (commit 6b1f9c)

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for infra/daemon/dcgm-exporter r1234 -> 6 nodes

alex: nice. One more: we should update the grafana dashboard for gpu agent health to add a metric for socket bind failures (counter) so we can correlate with reboots vs config drift.

maria: added a grafana card suggestion in the PR comments.

sre-oncall: FYI — I silenced the GPU_EXPORTER_SCRAPE_FAIL alert for us-east-1/gpu-pool for 30m to avoid noisy pages while we roll.

kyle: can everyone review the PR? I'll merge after +2. After merge we'll trigger a fleet redeploy hook to update systemd on remaining nodes and push a node-image patch for the next AMI bake.

jamal: one postmortem note: we should include a small test in infra CI that simulates stricter umask and checks runtime dir perms for critical agents. Prevents recurrence.

alex: agreed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
